propositions: Rebar lacks an aggregation layer and passive instrumentation to surface agent-driven dev-loop trends, code-health decay, and gate ROI over time via date-range queries.
Three tier-C blindspots leave no durable trace in the event store: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (caused_by), and bug outcome classification (close_class).

The solution derives metrics structurally from the event store and adds minimal passive emission only where signals leave no trace, stamped by trustworthy code (gate handlers, git blame) not agent self-report.
Auto-derived caused_by edges bypass the closed-source guard by writing directly to the link store via _write_link_event, and are labeled best-effort/classified-confidence, never authoritative.
Bug close replaces the required free-text --reason with a bounded --class enum persisted on the STATUS event, keeping required-argument count flat.
Snapshots are written to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (git-tracked) rather than reports/ (gitignored), ensuring durability.
